as_told.title: Mountain bike incident turns Blitch from skeptic

plain: John Blitch, a scientist who worked with DARPA, the Pentagon's advanced research agency, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1995 he went on a mountain bike ride at Daniels Park, a site south of Denver, Colorado, said to hold an old burial ground. He says he lost at least five hours he cannot account for, something his wife Cindy is part of the story of, and that before this ride he had been a skeptic. He presents it as the event that changed his mind about contact with non-human beings.
